title: Everyone, sorted into 217 boxes
variant: The template at its plainest, with no map or time axis
prompt: Give me population and income data for every country so I can slice it myself.
note: The plainest of the three, and included to show the template with the spectacle removed: no map, no globe, no time axis, 17 KB of data and 217 rows. What is left is the argument for the shape itself, which is that the breakdown control does the work a chart cannot: region and income group are two different cuts of the same rows and the page says outright that region is a filing system rather than a size, since South Asia is six countries and Sub-Saharan Africa is forty-eight. The scatter uses a log axis because the range runs four orders of magnitude, and says so under the chart rather than leaving the reader to notice.
